metric_definitions.prefix_probability: Equal-weight mean over 20 neutral prompts of full-vocabulary autoregressive probability of the union of minimal canonical singular fruit-name prefixes (lower/title case, with/without leading space); EOS excluded; no fruit-catalog renormalization.
metric_definitions.whole_word_mention: Count among 400 sampled responses matching any registered singular/plural/alias at whole-word boundaries, case-insensitive; includes negation and does not mean affirmative preference.
metric_definitions.exact_name: Count among 400 naturally EOS-terminated responses that normalize to exactly one catalog alias; strip outer whitespace and terminal punctuation, casefold; no explanations/negations/lists.

interpretation: Exploratory comparison of one red-only training seed. Rankings apply only to the preregistered 50-fruit catalog. Prefix probability is not exact-answer probability, catalog events can overlap, and there is no fruit-only renormalization. Mentions include negations. Ratio is undefined at a zero base rate; tiny denominators can dominate rankings. Prompt-bootstrap intervals describe prompt variation, not training-seed uncertainty; zero sample counts do not prove zero probability. Intervals are unadjusted for catalog-wide selection.
additional_caveats: Rankings apply only to the fixed 50-fruit catalog.
Prefix probabilities exclude EOS, allow continuations, may overlap across fruits, and are not fruit-only normalized.
Sampled exact fruit-name replies allow recorded singular/plural aliases and terminal punctuation; native EOS is required.
Whole-word mentions include negations and truncated replies; multiple fruits may occur in one reply.
Zero baseline yields an undefined ratio, not infinite growth. Zero sample counts do not prove zero probability.
Tiny positive baselines can dominate raw ratios; the 0.1% floor does not guarantee adequate sampled baseline counts.
Prompt-bootstrap intervals are unadjusted for selecting extremes and do not measure training-seed uncertainty.
One historical red-only B8 checkpoint/seed, 00–99 carrier, minimal teacher prompt; no neutral-SFT control, so red-specific causation is not established.
